_what: Runbook Phase 8 / plan §5.1 axis 4 — INTERFERENCE, C-BLOCK × C-STRUCT on one gate. Sited at J8, the one gate where a block effect is measured and credited tonight (P7d: h_forecast 위로 4/10 → 9/10, placebo clean) and where a C-STRUCT payload with a real directional pull exists (P7c's case/person list, null alone). 2×2 factorial: {case-first, person-first} × {no block, h_forecast}. The conflict cell is BLOCK-UNDER-CASE-FIRST (priorities pull the case, the block pulls the person); the alignment cell is BLOCK-UNDER-PERSON-FIRST. The single-channel arms are the factorial's own controls; both component manipulations carry measured placebos from tonight (P7d placebo clean, P7c placebo null), which is why this suite has no separate placebo arm — declared here per the runner's warning.

_authoring_provenance.escape_option_declaration: Runbook Phase 8 requires this named up front: the block-pull (위로, person) and the case-pull (추궁/침묵) CAN both be partially served by 거래 — hand the exculpation over to get case information back. 거래 is the escape option of §5.1 axis 4 at this gate. It has measured 0/50 across every J8 arm tonight (P5 ×3, P7c ×3, P7d ×3 — empirically inert), but if the conflict cell's movement lands on 거래, the conflict was absorbed by the escape and a null there is UNATTRIBUTABLE, not negative — pre-registered as such.

what_each_cell_asks: block (case-first + h_forecast) vs baseline: does the credited block effect SURVIVE a hostile priority ordering? This is the conflict cell and the axis-4 question proper.

both (person-first + h_forecast) vs block: does an aligned ordering ADD anything to the block effect? C-STRUCT is 0-for-3 alone tonight; if it contributes under alignment, order matters only as reinforcement — a design-relevant asymmetry.
struct vs baseline: P7c's null, replicated byte-identically.

Cross-suite indicative only: block cell vs P7d's live (9/10) differs by the list (4-line case-first vs 2-line S1) — the delta between them is the ordering's suppression effect, read qualitatively, never pooled.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J8 under K1 on template v0.4 with the P5 stance set and P7c's four-line priority list: (1) injecting h_forecast moves the stance distribution toward 위로 (d) off the baseline's mode EVEN under the case-first ordering (conflict cell); (2) the person-first ordering does not measurably add to the block's effect (alignment cell ≈ conflict cell), consistent with C-STRUCT's three measured nulls; (3) the ordering alone moves nothing (struct ≈ baseline, P7c replication). Shift form per A1. The axis-4 deliverable is which of (1)/(2) fails and how, not a verdict on either channel.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 위로 (d) — the predicted stance — the site is at ceiling and the suite is void (A14; P7c measured this baseline at 위로 2/10, so firing means non-replication, reported first). READ CONDITIONS, pre-registered: conflict cell indistinguishable from baseline on 위로 (one-sided Fisher p > 0.05) = the hostile ordering SUPPRESSES the credited block effect — an axis-4 positive finding about C-STRUCT's veto power, not a null; conflict cell moves but lands on 거래 = escape absorbed the conflict, unattributable (declared above); alignment cell > conflict cell at p < 0.05 = ordering contributes under alignment only; struct cell moving off baseline at p < 0.05 = P7c's null failed to replicate, which supersedes the other readings and is reported first.
contingencies: OBJECTIVE COLOR (secondary, self-coded, flagged): inner_note coded for the pursued objective per call, as at P7c/P7d.
TRACEABILITY: block-carrying arms citing h_forecast is the check; baseline/struct fabricated ids expected (A5).
ARM COMPARABILITY per A15 across all four arms.

NO SEPARATE PLACEBO ARM, declared: the factorial's single-channel cells are its controls, and both components carry same-night measured placebos (P7d placebo clean, P7c placebo null). A mechanism claim beyond axis-4 interference is not made from this suite.
OWNERSHIP: C-STRUCT component authored unattended, pending 윤석's review; joint phase per the runbook's line table.
